title: After the Arima Kinen: My Miracle

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sweep Tosho puts in an amazing run and takes first place. The sheer commitment to her performance leaves the crowd quivering with excitement.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With her peers utterly engrossed by Sweep Tosho, Tokai Teio looks on with a slightly frustrated, but ultimately happy expression.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She even praises Sweep Tosho's running, acknowledging that it truly excited the audience.
